item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Creates one `dspy.Predict('question -> answer')` and reuses it for all three calls, with call-time LM/adapter resolution via global/context settings."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"The first outer call uses `chat_lm` with `ChatAdapter`, and the recorded system message is checked for `[[ ## question ## ]]`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Inside `dspy.context`, the same predictor runs against `xml_lm` with `XMLAdapter`, and the system message is checked for `<question>` and against chat markers."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"After the context exits, the third call reuses the same predictor with the default chat LM again, and the recorded post-context system message is asserted to contain chat markers."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"It prints before/inside/after system messages and asserts chat markers on both outer calls, XML tags on the inner call, and absence of `[[ ## question ## ]]` in the XML call."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
